title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC High
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and the Microsoft documentation checked in this run, including the updated Copilot Dashboard licensing passage. It reports the conflicting availability and licensing statements rather than choosing one, and explicitly warns that VFAM access controls are unavailable in GCC High.

claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard is currently not available for national/regional cloud deployments including but not limited to Microsoft’s U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.

Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights

IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.quote:
Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy
    -FeatureId <String>
    -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean>
    -ModuleId <String>
    -Name <String>
    [-Confirm]
    [-Everyone]

claims.where: controls[0].governs; controls[0].scope; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The general web app access controls support tenant, user and group scope, with individual and group access managed using Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: You can turn access to the Viva Insights web app on or off for individual users or groups using Microsoft Entra ID. ... at the tenant, group, or user level

claims.claim: Adding or removing web app users takes effect in 24 hours.
claims.quote: When you add or remove users to the Viva Insights web app, the change will go into effect in 24 hours.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator has no automatic web app access and must add themselves.

claims.claim: For tenants without a Viva Insights licence, the printed Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Manage minimum group size.
claims.quote: go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights. ... Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell operation for setting the Copilot Dashboard minimum group size was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Dashboard minimum group size PowerShell Microsoft Graph API privacy settings; "Copilot Dashboard" "minimum group size" "PowerShell". Read settings, privacy-settings and Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy; no operation found.

claims.claim: The minimum group size setting applies to the AI Administrator and Viva Insights Administrator.
claims.quote:
Set minimum group size for the Copilot Dashboard and Agent Dashboard
Applies to: AI Administrator and Viva Insights Administrator

claims.claim: The minimum group size defaults to 10 employees.
claims.quote: the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.claim: The configurable minimum group size cannot be lower than five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five

claims.where: controls[1].governs; controls[1].scope; Risk assessment: Data exposure

claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set

claims.claim: Without an exclusion list, dashboard insights include employees with Copilot licences, Viva Insights licences or a manual cohort upload.
claims.quote: If you don't create an exclusion list, all employees who either have a Copilot license, a Viva Insights license, or are uploaded manually using the Cohort upload feature in the admin center, are included in dashboard insights

claims.claim: An exclusion list requires its policy to be turned on.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The environments page says the G5 requirement ends after mid-November through early December 2026, leaving standalone Copilot functionality.
claims.quote: After mid-November through early December 2026, your tenant won't need a G5 license and will only need standalone Copilot functionality.

claims.claim: The required Microsoft Copilot licence is available as an add-on for eligible US Government plans, supporting the add-on licensing model.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available as an add-on in Government Community Cloud (GCC), Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), and Department of Defense (DoD) environments for the following plans.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: No GCC High dashboard price was found, and the environment requirements page publishes no price.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Analytics GCC High pricing dashboard Copilot Credits meter; "Copilot Analytics" "GCC" "price". Read supported-environments, environment-requirements, copilot-license-options and Viva service description; no GCC High dashboard price found.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The environment requirements page directs customers to their Microsoft account team for pricing.
claims.quote: Contact your Microsoft account team for pricing.

claims.claim: The environment requirements page states a minimum of 50 assigned Viva Insights licences for advanced analysis.
claims.quote: At least 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses are required to access advanced analysis and the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.

claims.claim: The environment requirements page also states a minimum of 50 assigned Viva Insights licences for the Copilot Dashboard, unlike the other thresholds reported.
claims.quote: At least 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses are required to access advanced analysis and the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.

claims.claim: The updated Copilot Dashboard page says processing starts with 50 assigned Viva Insights licences or one assigned Copilot licence.
claims.quote: A minimum of 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses, or 1 assigned Copilot license (including the Viva Insights service plan), is required for data processing to kick off.

claims.claim: The Viva service description says the Copilot Dashboard and Advanced Copilot Reporting come with Microsoft 365 Copilot or 10 Insights licences.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard and Advanced Copilot Reporting in Viva Insights comes with Microsoft 365 Copilot or 10 Insights licenses.

claims.claim: The pages checked document no dashboard meter or Copilot Credit charge for viewing these dashboards.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Analytics GCC High pricing dashboard Copilot Credits meter. Read cited licensing and dashboard pages and search excerpts from Monitor Copilot Credit spending and Billing rates and management; credits meter agent usage, not dashboard viewing.

claims.claim: Viva Insights requires applicable licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.
claims.quote: Viva Insights requires the applicable Viva Insights licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.

claims.claim: The general settings page assigns management of the Agent Dashboard control to the AI Administrator.
claims.quote: Enable or disable the Agent Dashboard ... Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can manage all settings described on the settings page.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: The settings page says the previous Copilot Dashboard access controls in the admin center and PowerShell are no longer available.
claims.quote: Previous controls to manage access to the dashboard using the Copilot Dashboard control in the Microsoft 365 admin center or using PowerShell are no longer available.

claims.claim: Policies previously removing Copilot Dashboard access now apply to the entire Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: If you previously removed access to the Copilot Dashboard using Copilot Dashboard feature access management control or PowerShell, those configurations now apply to the entire Viva Insights web app.

claims.claim: The general settings page documents exclusion-list management using VFAM or PowerShell.
claims.quote: You can manage the exclusion list with Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) using PowerShell or VFAM.

claims.claim: The unified exclusion list hides chosen employees from dashboard aggregates and other Viva Insights reports.
claims.quote: The user exclusion list allows admins to specify which employees' data should not be shown in the dashboard or other Viva Insights reports.

claims.claim: The settings page itself does not give the exclusion list's admin navigation path.
claims.quote: Searched: Create a unified exclusion list section in manage-settings-copilot-dashboard. Read the entire section; it describes CSV files, Entra groups and VFAM/PowerShell, linking to VFAM without giving navigation steps.

claims.where: Scope; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the rollout mechanism for this GCC High roadmap item beyond the target month.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Copilot Analytics GCC High default automatic rollout web app. Read roadmap, supported-environments, settings, Copilot Dashboard and Analytics introduction; no GCC High item-specific rollout mechanism found.

claims.claim: Uploaded organizational attributes feed dashboard group filters.

claims.claim: Employee activity data feeds aggregated dashboard reports.
claims.quote: The analyzed population in the dashboard includes all employees who have an assigned Copilot license. ... Metrics are aggregated at the tenant level or user level, depending on the licenses your tenant has.

claims.claim: Microsoft's licence options page says Copilot is available as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government and education plans.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans.
